system.description:
A dull grey, soul-trapping metal that is alive: always cold, seeming to pulse like something wormlike, and unsettling to anyone nearby. It follows the general magical-material rules (counts as Best, one hearthstone slot, magical damage).

Melee and ranged weapons deal +1k0 damage and impose -2k1 on attempts to parry or dodge them; special ammunition gains the Toxic quality; armour imposes -2k0 on attacks against the wearer. A bionic arm sheds all its critical damage at the start of each round and gives your unarmed or natural attacks the Toxic quality; bionic legs heal their critical damage each round the same way and let you rise from prone for free when your turn begins, without provoking Opportunity Attacks; with a bionic heart, whenever a Hero Point is about to be burned to stay alive, roll 1d10: on 5 or less it is kept.
system.effectText: Weapons impose -2k1 to parry/dodge and +1k0 damage; ammo Toxic; armour -2k0 to be hit; bionics self-heal crits.
